name: Spicebomb (3-4)
disable: DC 15 Thievery check to remove the bombs without activating them or DC 16 Survival check (trained) to render them inert.

items.name: Peppery Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on a spice bomb

---

Effect The spice bombs explode into clouds of spicy, choking gas that envelops the area. All creatures within 30 feet must succeed a DC 16 Fortitude save save or take 2d10 poison damage. On a critical failure, the creature takes full damage and is Sickened 1.

text: Several spice bombs disguised as rocks litter the ground.
